_comment: Canonical ld-config template for the life-dashboard producers. The live file is assembled from this shape at install time; every [UPPER_SNAKE] placeholder must be filled or the shared gate (ld_config_gate.py) refuses the config. morning_triage.chat_db_path is the absolute path to the owner Mac's Messages DB, e.g. /Users/<mac-username>/Library/Messages/chat.db, and morning_triage.exclude.imessage_handles is the exclusion list the iMessage triage reads. calendar.sources[].calendar_id must be a globally-unique calendar id (the ...@group.calendar.google.com / email form) visible to the account Latch's gog is authenticated as; 'primary' is valid only for that one account's own calendar.

sports._comment: Followed teams for the kiosk sports card. Demo default — customize to your teams. abbr = ESPN team abbreviation; sport/league name its ESPN scoreboard.
